svg.text: Contents checklist, bill of materials, construction & cutting list
SHEET 7 - CONTENTS CHECKLIST, BILL OF MATERIALS, CONSTRUCTION & CUTTING LIST
CONTENTS CHECKLIST - 64 tips (32 pairs), 5 cables, 14 accessories: where each item lives
Totals: 17 pairs x 10 cm (34 tips) on panels A + B; 15 pairs x 5 cm (30 tips) on panels C + D; 32 pairs / 64 tips.
Accessories: 6 end caps + 4 keys -> face 1 loops; 3 connectors + grip patch -> face 2; 5 cables -> face 2 pocket.
Lining, faux leather 0.6-0.8 mm or cotton
Greyboard 1.5 mm: panels A, B, page
Snap backing patches, leather 2 x 2 cm
behind lid studs / panel B studs
1. Cut outer shell and lining from sheet 1 (net + allowance). Score fold lines on the board side.
2. Make the three interior panels first (sheets 3-6): wrap board in lining, stitch bands / loops / pockets
through the lining BEFORE wrapping so no stitching shows on the back. Set panel B studs.
3. Set end-flap snap caps on the outer shell while flat. Studs on the lid outer face: mark from a dry fold.
4. Laminate board to the outer shell (base, lid, walls); turn / bind all edges; top-stitch at 0.3 cm.
5. Form the box: fold the walls, glue corner tabs or stitch the corners (box-stitch) outside-in.
6. Glue + edge-stitch panel A into the base, panel B into the lid; stitch the page hinge to the front wall.
7. Stitch the keeper flap to the tip edge of panel B. Check all 4 snaps engage cleanly.
8. Load the set in the order of the contents checklist and check the stack height closes without pressure.
Cut pieces +/- 0.1 cm; slot stitch lines +/- 0.05 cm (the 0.6 slot must still take two 2 mm tips); snap centres +/- 0.15 cm.
Interior panels are 0.5 cm smaller than the box interior in both directions to allow for lining thickness.
PROTOTYPE MEASUREMENT RECORD - what each photo contributed
Rear flap 5.0, rear wall 6.5, base 21.0 x 13.0, front wall 6.0, lid 12.7; side wall 5.7, end flap 8.0, snaps
Panel with 9 cm flap, large sizes (early draft)
Keeper flap depth 9.0; 20.5 panel length. Row widths superseded by photo 4
Slot widths 0.6-1.6 (= 6-16 mm), 0.5 lands, 1.0 end margins, 1.5 side margin
Slot widths 1.7-2.2, 0.5 lands, 0.5 top / 1.0 bottom margin, two snap tabs
Confirms photo 3 widths and 0.5 'between typical'; used for the 5 cm tip panel C
HARDWARE SIZE ASSUMPTIONS (loops sized to these; measure the real parts - Q6)
4.3 x 3.5 slip pocket, face 2 (patch folds in half)
